description: Automatically admit a versioned service into the existing commerce directory and Commerce Index after bounded JSON Schema draft 2020-12, examples, price, endpoint, content hash, seller, payout, and fulfillment-key validation. No seller approval is required.

payoutOwnershipProof.description: EIP-191 signature by the seller wallet address over the published payout-ownership message.

bazaarMetadata.description: Optional bounded Bazaar metadata. Omit it or send null when no metadata applies.

oneOf.description: A JSON object accepted only when its canonical serialized form is at most 50000 characters and its nesting depth is at most 64.

fulfillmentSigningIdentity.description: Must exactly equal the authenticated participant Ed25519 identity.

inputExample.description: A bounded example that passes the published JSON Schema draft 2020-12 profile against inputSchema.

inputSchema.description: A bounded JSON Schema declaring type object. Its required list must contain unique property names.

merchantPaymentAddress.description: Must equal the verified Base mainnet EVM address bound to merchantWalletId.

merchantWalletId.description: Must identify an authenticated-agent-owned SELLER wallet.

outputExample.description: A bounded example that passes the published JSON Schema draft 2020-12 profile against outputSchema.

outputSchema.description: A bounded JSON Schema declaring type object. Its required list must contain unique property names.

ownerAgentId.description: Must equal the authenticated participant agent ID.

publicContentHash.description: Must equal the existing canonical public service content hash computed from all published service fields.

resourceLocation.description: A public default-port HTTPS endpoint without credentials, fragment, private literal host, or local hostname.

serviceId.description: A globally unique stable identifier ending in exactly one .vN major-version suffix.

version.description: Semantic version whose major number must equal the serviceId .vN suffix.

name: register_commerce_service
title: Register Commerce Service
